        ### Question

        ### Options

opb. Dry, scaly, hyperkeratotic papule
opc. A single, large pink patch
opd. Dermatophyte infection
ope. UVC exposure

CHAIN: "Repeated sunburns" -> "skin damage" -> "keratinocyte dysplasia" -> "squamous cell carcinoma" -> "A single, large pink patch" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Chronic irritation" -> "skin changes" -> "possible precancerous lesions" -> "increased risk of squamous cell carcinoma" -> "Hamartomatous lesion of sebaceous glands" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Dermatophyte infection" -> "inflammation and skin changes" -> "possible skin damage" -> "unclear link to squamous cell carcinoma" -> 60%
